purpose: Controlled personal rifle mechanical feedback, driven by original weapon.mechanical events in the main game.

originals.author: LFA
originals.evidence: Source page lists CC0. Author describes a mixture of bolt-action rifle, stapler and tape-measure recordings.

originals.author: BMacZero (Brian MacIntosh)
originals.evidence: Source page lists CC0 and says credit to Brian MacIntosh is optional.

processing: DC removal, peak bounded to 0.65, 1ms attack and 15ms tail fades
limitations: The mixed LFA recording contains a rifle, stapler and tape measure; the object producing each excerpt is not verified.
Cue mappings are Foley choices, not verified Type 24 or Japanese rifle mechanisms.
extract means bolt extraction motion, not proof of an ejected case or a case striking the ground.
load is generic clip-loading audio, not a verified period five-round stripper-clip recording.
No independent listening acceptance or battlefield mix acceptance is claimed.
Regeneration requires FFmpeg; different FFmpeg versions may change hashes and require explicit review.
